questions.text: Under the 'Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana' (PMJDY), which of the following services is NOT automatically provided to a new account holder?

options.label: C
options.text: Insurance cover of Rs. 30,000 for accidental death

questions.solution: Shortcut: Recall the standard features of PMJDY – it offers RuPay card, basic insurance and DBT, but overdraft is a later add‑on, not automatic. Full solution: Every PMJDY account gets a RuPay debit card, an accidental death insurance cover of Rs. 30,000 and is linked to DBT for subsidies. The overdraft facility up to Rs. 5,000 is available only after meeting credit criteria and is not automatically granted. Therefore, option B is correct.

questions.text: As per the latest RBI guidelines, which of the following categories of borrowers is eligible for a concessional interest rate under the 'Interest Subvention Scheme for MSMEs'?

options.label: A
options.text: Micro enterprises with turnover below Rs. 5 crore

options.label: B
options.text: Large manufacturing units with turnover above Rs. 500 crore

options.label: C
options.text: Export‑oriented units with foreign exchange earnings above Rs. 100 crore

options.label: D
options.text: All scheduled commercial banks irrespective of borrower type

questions.solution: Shortcut: The scheme targets the smallest businesses – micro‑enterprises – for rate relief. Eliminate options that refer to large firms, export units or banks themselves. Full solution: The RBI’s Interest Subvention Scheme for MSMEs provides a subsidy on the lending rate for micro enterprises (annual turnover < Rs. 5 crore) to improve credit flow. Larger firms and export‑oriented units are not covered, and the scheme is borrower‑centric, not bank‑centric. Therefore, option A is correct.

questions.text: As per the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), 2016, and subsequent notifications issued by the Central Government, what is the current minimum amount of default required for a creditor to initiate the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) against a corporate debtor?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Legislative Timeline Elimination): The original threshold (2016) was ₹1 Lakh (Option A). A 2020 COVID-19 notification permanently raised it to ₹1 Crore (Option C). Proposals for ₹10 Crore (Option D) exist but are not yet notified; ₹10 Lakh (Option B) was never a threshold. Step-by-step: Section 4 of IBC empowers the Central Government to notify the minimum default. Initially notified as ₹1 Lakh. Via Notification S.O. 1205(E) dated 24th March 2020, the threshold was enhanced to ₹1 Crore to exclude small defaults during the pandemic. This ₹1 Crore limit remains the current operative statutory threshold as no subsequent notification has revised it further.
questions.topic: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) / Banking Regulation

questions.text: The RBI introduced the 'Digital Payments Security Framework' in 2022. Which of the following is the primary objective of this framework?

options.label: A
options.text: To standardise security protocols for all digital payment instruments

options.label: B
options.text: To increase the interest rates on digital savings accounts

options.label: C
options.text: To mandate the use of blockchain for all interbank settlements

options.label: D
options.text: To provide tax incentives for fintech startups

questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate options that are unrelated to security. Options B, C and D talk about rates, blockchain mandate and tax incentives – none are core to a security framework. The remaining option A directly mentions standardising security protocols, which is the objective. Full solution: The Digital Payments Security Framework was issued by RBI to lay down uniform security standards for payment gateways, wallets and other digital payment instruments, ensuring protection against fraud and cyber‑threats. Hence, option A is correct.

questions.text: The RBI's 'External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs)' framework caps the maturity period for borrowing in foreign currency for infrastructure projects. What is the maximum permissible maturity?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Recall the standard ECB rule – infrastructure projects can have up to 20‑year maturity. Eliminate the shorter and longer durations. Full solution: Under the ECB guidelines, borrowing for infrastructure projects is allowed a maximum maturity of 20 years (or 25 years for certain greenfield projects, but the standard ceiling is 20 years). Hence, the correct answer is option C (20 years).

questions.text: In the following question, a part of the sentence is bold. Below are given alternatives to the bold part which may improve the sentence. Choose the correct alternative. If no improvement is needed, choose 'No improvement'. The manager insisted on the employees to work overtime to meet the deadline.
questions.solution: Shortcut: The verb 'insist' follows two correct patterns: 'insist on + gerund' (e.g., 'insisted on working') or 'insist that + subjunctive' (e.g., 'insisted that he work'). It never takes 'on + object + to-infinitive'. Option (A) uses the correct subjunctive structure. Worked Solution: The original sentence uses the incorrect structure 'insisted on the employees to work'. The verb 'insist' cannot be followed by an object + to-infinitive. Option (A) 'insisted that the employees work' correctly uses the subjunctive mood (base form 'work') after 'insist that'. Option (B) distorts the structure. Option (C) 'insisted on the employees working' uses a fused participle (object + gerund) which is considered less formal/incorrect in strict standard English compared to the possessive gerund ('employees' working') or the subjunctive clause in (A). Hence, (A) is the best improvement.

questions.text: Statements: All roses are flowers. Some flowers are lilies. No lily is a shrub. Conclusions: I. Some roses are lilies. II. No rose is a shrub. III. Some flowers are not shrubs. Which of the conclusions logically follow?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Only conclusion III must be true because the ‘some flowers are lilies’ together with ‘no lily is a shrub’ guarantees at least those lilies are flowers that are not shrubs. Full solution: Draw Venn diagrams; roses ⊂ flowers; some flowers overlap lilies; lilies and shrubs are disjoint. Hence some flowers (the lilies) are not shrubs → III follows. I and II are not forced.

questions.text: Statements: All pens are pencils. Some pencils are erasers. No eraser is a marker. Conclusions: I. Some pens are erasers. II. No pen is a marker. III. Some pencils are not markers. Which of the conclusions logically follow?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Draw mental Venn. All pens ⊂ pencils. Some pencils overlap erasers. Erasers and markers are disjoint. I: Pens may not be in the eraser overlap → not definite. II: Pencils could be markers → not definite. III: The pencils that are erasers are not markers, so at least some pencils are not markers → definite. Hence only III follows.

questions.text: Find the smallest three-digit number which when divided by 13 leaves a remainder of 7 and when divided by 17 leaves a remainder of 10.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Test options using divisibility. 163 ÷ 13 = 12 rem 7; 163 ÷ 17 = 9 rem 10. Only Option A satisfies both. Option B (176) gives rem 6 with 17. Option C (189) gives rem 2 with 17. Option D (202) gives rem 15 with 17. Full: Number N = 13a+7 = 17b+10 => 13a - 17b = 3. Smallest positive integer solution: a=12, b=9 (156-153=3). N = 13(12)+7 = 163. General form N = 163 + 221k; smallest 3-digit is 163.

questions.text: The RBI's 'Prompt Corrective Action' (PCA) framework lists several trigger parameters. Which of the following is NOT a trigger for initiating PCA?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Remember the three main PCA triggers – NPA, CAR, and Credit‑Deposit ratio. ROA is not part of the list. Full solution: The PCA framework uses Net NPA (>12%), CAR (<9%) and Credit‑Deposit ratio (>115%) as trigger thresholds. Return on Assets is a performance metric but not a PCA trigger. Hence, option C is the correct answer.

questions.text: In a coded blood relation language, the following symbols are used: 'P @ Q' means 'P is the father of Q'. 'P # Q' means 'P is the mother of Q'. 'P $ Q' means 'P is the brother of Q'. 'P % Q' means 'P is the sister of Q'. Based on the expression 'K @ L $ M # N % O', how is K related to O?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Generation Gap Method): Assign values: Father/Mother = +1; Brother/Sister = 0. Trace path K -> L (+1), L -> M (0), M -> N (+1), N -> O (0). Total Gap = +2 (Grandparent). Gender of K is Male (@). Path contains Mother (#) and Sister (%), indicating Maternal line. Hence, Maternal Grandfather. Step-by-step: K @ L => K is Father of L. L $ M => L is Brother of M => K is Father of M. M # N => M is Mother of N => K is Maternal Grandfather of N. N % O => N is Sister of O => K is Maternal Grandfather of O.

questions.text: Starting from point X, Rahul walks 9 m north, turns right and walks 12 m, turns left and walks 3 m, turns left and walks 3 m. What is the straight‑line distance between his final position and point X?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Compute net north‑south and east‑west displacements: north 9+3=12 m, east 12 m, west 3 m → net east 9 m. The final coordinates are (9,12), a 3‑4‑5 triangle scaled by 3, giving distance 15 m. Full solution: After each turn update coordinates; final position (9,12); distance = √(9²+12²)=15 m.

questions.text: Read the sentence to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any, will be in one part of the sentence. Mark the part with the error as your answer. The panel of experts appointed by the government (A) / have recommended a complete overhaul (B) / of the existing tax structure (C) / to boost revenue collection. (D)

options.label: A
options.text: The panel of experts appointed by the government

questions.solution: Shortcut: Ignore the prepositional phrase 'of experts' between the subject and verb. The main subject is 'The panel' (singular collective noun), so the verb must be singular 'has recommended'. Worked Solution: The subject of the sentence is 'The panel', which is a singular collective noun. The phrase 'of experts appointed by the government' is a prepositional phrase modifying the subject and does not affect the verb number. Therefore, the plural verb 'have recommended' in part (B) is incorrect; it should be 'has recommended'. Parts (A), (C), and (D) are grammatically correct.

questions.text: Two trains of lengths 180 m and 220 m run on parallel tracks. When running in opposite directions, they cross each other in 10 seconds. When running in the same direction, the faster train crosses the slower train in 40 seconds. What is the speed of the faster train in km/h?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Total length = 400 m. Opposite relative speed = 400/10 = 40 m/s (Sum of speeds). Same direction relative speed = 400/40 = 10 m/s (Difference of speeds). Faster speed = (Sum + Diff)/2 = (40+10)/2 = 25 m/s. Convert: 25 × 18/5 = 90 km/h. Full: Let speeds be x, y m/s (x>y). x+y = 400/10 = 40. x-y = 400/40 = 10. Adding: 2x = 50 => x = 25 m/s = 25 × 18/5 = 90 km/h.

questions.text: A is the brother of B. C is the father of A. D is the sister of C. E is the mother of D. How is E related to B?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Trace the parental line upward twice – B’s father is C, and C’s mother is E, so E is B’s grandmother. Full solution: A and B share father C; D is C’s sister, so D is aunt of B; E is mother of C and D, making her grandmother of B.
